-- script --
start /home/evan
size 60 12
note one candidate completes, a folder gaining its slash
type pho
press tab
state filter photos/
snapshot photos
note the start the candidates share is added
press ctrl+u
type r
press tab
state filter read
note no more to share: Tab steps through the candidates
press tab
state filter readings.txt
press tab
state filter readme.md
press tab
state filter readings.txt
press shift+tab
state filter readme.md
snapshot cycling
note typing ends the stepping
type x
state filter readme.mdx
